Field Name
Description
IncidentStartTime
Time of the first activity in the incident
IncidentEndTime
Time of the latest activity in the incident
FalconHostLink
URL to view the incident in Falcon console
State
Shows if the incident is still active
Values:
open = the incident is still active
closed = the incident is not active
FineScore
The highest incident score reached as of the time the event was sent
The value is a decimal value in the range of 0.1 to 10
The value can only go up over time, and it signifies the maximum severity of the incident over its entire lifetime.
LateralMovement
Gives info about lateral movement in the incident
Values:
0 = No lateral movement detected in incident
1 = Lateral movement detected in incident
IncidentType
Gives info about the type of incident
Values:
1 = Normal incident from the CrowdScore engine
2 = Overwatch incident
IncidentID
The incident ID of the incident
This value in IncidentSummaryEvent is the same as the one found using /incidents/queries/incidents/v1.
HostID
The host ID that's associated with the incident
This value shows exactly one host.
Use the host_ids in the full incident available in the
to see all hosts
where the incident occurred.
